problems.problem: Prose: the context clause ‘dealings in trade follow the orphan’s wealth’ can be read as trade pursuing the orphan’s wealth, which misstates the passage; what is meant is that in the list of sacred duties (6:151 to 6:152) the clause on full measure comes after the clause on the orphan’s property. A reader at six in the morning meets an unclear, even misleading, first half.
problems.fix: s = ‘Among the sacred duties the Prophet is told to recite, the rule of fair trade follows the one on the orphan’s wealth; al-Tabari, on 6:152, reads ‘beyond its scope’ as asking no payer for more than the due, and no payee to settle for less.’ (45 words; gated ok in scratch/crit3-fix-16.json); reading, key and src unchanged.
